integration_base.policy: Preserve current main and canonical owners; targeted semantic adaptation only. This ledger authorizes no remote merge, production launch or release.

inventory.discovery: Paginated connected-user open PR inventory (limit 1000; first snapshot 179), crosschecked with disjoint all-author created-date search partitions (<2026-11-17:62; 2026-11-17:83; 2026-11-18:7; 2026-11-19:28), then #5699 and #5700 captured before cutoff.
inventory.scope: All 181 open PRs present in the captured snapshot. PRs or head changes after cutoff are deliberately excluded and require a later refresh.

selected_delivery_workloads.name: Jeeves typed guided workflows and duplicate AI route cleanup
selected_delivery_workloads.acceptance: Typed user choice persists into the executed canonical workflow; duplicate surface cleanup preserves deep links, authentication, cancellation and useful unavailable states. Static content helpers alone do not qualify.

selected_delivery_workloads.name: Dragon NativeProduction saved and revised projects
selected_delivery_workloads.ownership: Current Dragon product and project owners
selected_delivery_workloads.acceptance: A user can create, save, reopen and revise a project using current authority; published source and artifact identities remain bound. Original asset and physical renderer evidence remain separately scoped.

selected_delivery_workloads.name: Skeleton Forge build and source ZIP durability
selected_delivery_workloads.ownership: Current Forge builder, durable jobs and source export owners
selected_delivery_workloads.acceptance: A build is observable, restart/retry behavior is bounded, and a finished source ZIP can be downloaded and independently verified after process recovery without false success.

interpretation_limits: No source code was modified and no new product/native/model tests were executed by this reconciliation task.
Workflow conclusions are observed GitHub metadata, not a claim that every required gate ran. Secret scanning and dynamic Analyze(actions) are not product or model qualification.
Only the explicitly listed job-level evidence was inspected. Two sampled failed Emerald push registrations return zero jobs; this is not an assertion about logs of every failed run.
Recorded base SHA, indexed parent head and actual Git ancestry are all retained. Ancestry absence is not proof of missing behavior: cherry-picked equivalent patches can already be present.
Comparison path counts are Git byte comparisons, not semantic defect counts. A donor-to-main two-tree deletion does not authorize deleting current main files.
Static template helpers do not complete a user journey. Source-only tests do not qualify production GGUF, GPU, Unreal, browser artwork or competitive superiority.

All 22 asset-deposit PRs add only one README relative to their recorded base at the captured heads; original bytes may be transported through separate retained Git blob paths and must be verified independently.
Maintained contract and mirror owners must be rechecked if any source is later adapted; do not replace contracts, provider boundaries, source pins or entire donor trees mechanically.

all_observed_run_metadata.note: Exactly the 1613 run IDs observed in the frozen inventory. Metadata was read again after cutoff; original cutoff conclusions remain preserved independently in pr-audit-full.json. No newer run IDs are included.

external_audit.retention: Keep all three external artifacts together. The frozen full JSON retains original status timestamps, source comparisons, paths, deposit inspection and job-level evidence; this repository ledger is its compact review projection.
